checkout.payHint0: All prices include VAT; shipping costs may apply (shown in the cart).
checkout.payHint1: Shipping: Germany 2–4 business days, EU 3–6 business days. Shipment tracking via email.
checkout.payHint2: Returns & Right of Withdrawal: 14 days from receipt. Please return items unused and in their original condition. You can obtain a return label via your account or our support. Returns within Germany are free of charge.
checkout.payHint3: Warranty: 24 months statutory warranty on physical products for consumers.
checkout.payHint4: Payment methods: Credit card, PayPal, SEPA direct debit, giropay/Sofort, purchase on account (B2B subject to approval).
checkout.payHint5: Invoice: PDF invoice by email. If a valid VAT ID is provided (EU/B2B), a net invoice will be issued under the reverse-charge mechanism where applicable.
checkout.payHint6: By clicking "Pay", you place a binding order with an obligation to pay.
